source_instruction: i want silver and noise cancelling earbuds.
query: Oh my gosh, you will not believe what happened on my walk over here today! I stopped to grab an iced lavender latte from that little corner spot by the park, and a tiny fluffy golden retriever puppy waddled right up to my table, stole the last bite of my lemon poppyseed muffin off my plate, then immediately rolled over for belly scritches like he hadn’t just committed a full-on pastry heist. The owner was so apologetic, but I couldn’t even be mad—he had little white sock markings on his paws and was wearing a tiny knit sweater covered in daisies, and he kept nudging my hand with his wet nose like he was proud of his heist. I ended up sitting there for ten extra minutes just petting him while his owner told me he’s only three months old and already has a rap sheet for stealing baked goods from every outdoor patio within a two-block radius. Hey, can you help me find a pair of headphones from this section? I need them to have static muting for when I’m studying in busy cafes, and I only want to pay a reasonable amount for them, nothing that feels like a total ripoff. I definitely have a specific colorway I’m set on, you know, the one I always go for that matches my phone case and laptop sleeve? I don’t want any other random features I’ll never use, just that core functionality I mentioned, and I’m not open to going higher than what feels like a fair price point for what I’m getting.
